rules.description: Verifies that poverty rate values are non-negative (minimum >= 0%).
Verifies that poverty rate values do not exceed 100%.
Verifies that county place count falls within expected range (3100-3250).
Verifies time series spans from 1990 through at least 2021.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate FROM stats
params.condition: TRY_CAST(MinDate AS INT) = 1990 AND TRY_CAST(MaxDate AS INT) >= 2021

rules.description: Ensures no unresolvable property or node references exist in output MCF.
Ensures zero MCF/TMCF syntax or lint errors in generated outputs.
Allows up to 0.1% deleted records for minor county FIPS boundary changes.
